description: This file implements a wave analyzer for external digital signals, used for debugging and signal analysis within the rusEfi engine management system. It includes initialization, callback handling, and data reporting for wave input signals, and integrates with the engine's sniffer and trigger systems.

classes.name: WaveReader
classes.description: Represents a wave input channel, storing signal timing data and event counters.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the WaveReader hardware is initialized and started.

methods.name: waAnaWidthCallback
methods.description: Callback for width measurement of wave signals.

methods.name: WaveReader::onFallEvent
methods.description: Handles fall (low) edge events for the wave input.

methods.name: setWaveModeSilent
methods.description: Sets the wave input mode to silent.

methods.name: initWave
methods.description: Initializes a wave input channel with specified name and index.

methods.name: waTriggerEventListener
methods.description: Listener for trigger events to measure engine cycle duration.

methods.name: waThread
methods.description: Thread function for periodic wave chart publishing.

methods.name: getWaveLowWidth
methods.description: Returns the last measured low width of the wave signal.

methods.name: getSignalOnTime
methods.description: Returns the on-time duration of the signal in milliseconds.

methods.name: getWaveOffset
methods.description: Returns the wave offset in microseconds.

methods.name: getSignalPeriodMs
methods.description: Returns the signal period in milliseconds.

methods.name: reportWave
methods.description: Reports wave signal parameters to logging.

methods.name: printWave
methods.description: Prints wave information for channels 0 and 1.
